newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips says to stick to core businesses.
newsitem.headline: Philips says to stick to core businesses.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV, reporting a bottom line 1996 loss, said on Thursday it was focusing on existing core businesses rather than moving into new areas.

"At this stage we are focusing on building our 100 existing businesses, rather than acquiring businesses in new areas or strategically reshaping the portfolio," new Philips chairman Cor Boonstra said in a statement.
Philips earlier announced a 1996 net loss of 590 million guilders after a net 1.3 billion guilders of restructuring charges, compared to the 1995 net profit of 2.52 billion.

Boonstra reiterated his policy of weeding out the company's underperformers and loss makers. "While this process is not yet complete, it is on schedule, and we are rapidly disposing of actvities that absorb profits, cash and management time."
